name: Craftsman's Writ: Big Bronze Bomb
summary: A transferable writ requests one Big Bronze Bomb and gives delivery and payment details. You need the writ with you to complete the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: The faded note asks you to bring one Big Bronze Bomb. It also names a delivery place and payment, and says the writ can pass from hand to hand. Keep it with you for the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Big Bronze Bomb.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the bomb?
faq.answer: The writ points to the delivery location marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ for the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
